attackers_goals: Attackers may use WinRM to execute code on remote hosts, in an attempt to gain persistence or move laterally in the network.
description: The endpoint performed unfamiliar WinRM HTTP activity to a remote host.
investigative_actions: Correlate the WinRM HTTP request from the source host and understand which software initiated it. Verify that this isn't IT activity.
name: Rare Windows Remote Management (WinRM) HTTP Activity
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall EAL Logs
